persistence: Resolved schemas and existing data only, with no unresolved placeholders or suspended resolution
boundary: No cyclic/self-referential storage, local TYPE sections, wildcard TYPE dimensions, inferred model/native source/compiler/controller ABI or public strict equivalence; legacy ordering retained
